_comment: Project routing policy. Hermes CLI Kanban handles explicit Worker/Reviewer cards; OpenCode shared service handles independent Tester/Verifier cards; all other roles inherit Codex's configured default model. Dispatch and auto-run remain off.

hermesDesktop.evidence: Accessibility tree read from the Hermes Desktop window; Sessions/Bots tabs and Backend ready indicator present. Visual capture timed out, and GUI session creation could not be operated because coordinate input geometry is unavailable.

hermesCli.command: hermes --version; hermes kanban boards show; hermes gateway status
hermesCli.observed: CLI version and board read succeeded outside sandbox; gateway is stopped, so each card requires explicit dispatch. HERMES-SMOKE-002 card t_075840fe completed, run 24, exit 0, marker received.
hermesCli.provider: custom (run metadata; provider mapping not independently resolved)

hermesProject.evidence: hermes project create exit 0; project details confirmed in output

discovery.worktree: Hermes CLI exposes --worktree; GUI/session worktree behavior NOT_VERIFIED

verification.profileAndWorkspace: Default profile and project root discovered via CLI; HERMES-SMOKE-002 requested scratch but dispatcher created a worktree under the repo. GUI visibility is not required for CLI Kanban routing.

guiSmokeTest.note: Worker/Reviewer routing uses Hermes CLI Kanban cards, not GUI-created sessions. Board visibility is checked from the Kanban card/run trace.

opencode.modelSelection: inherit-active-opencode-configured-default; --model omitted; model_used not exposed in run metadata
opencode.summary: npm --prefix frontend run test -- --run -t \"calculates isTaskOverdue with frozen time and terminal exclusion\": 1 passed / 14 skipped; exit 0
opencode.evidence: After the user reported a further model configuration update, preflight and dry-run passed; the authorized smoke completed under role-verifier, no model override, exit 0. Earlier two attempts had failed before test execution on free-tier entitlement.

codex._comment: No model or effort override is sent; use the user's configured Codex defaults.

planner._why: Planner remains in Codex to coordinate and receive the worker/reviewer results. Coordinator does not write product code.

worker.workspace: dir:<repository-root> while the current baseline remains untracked/uncommitted; verify source in a local commit and worktree before relying on isolation
worker.isolation: serialized current-checkout cards while baseline is untracked; use worktrees only after verifying the required baseline is present
worker._worktreeNote: Historical smoke requested scratch but Hermes created an unregistered project worktree, later removed after verification. Current route: explicit dir:<repository-root>, Worker then OpenCode Tester then a separate read-only Hermes Reviewer, sequentially. CHPMIS-007 historically used a Codex Tester before OpenCode routing was adopted.

reviewer.workspace: dir:<repository-root> while baseline is uncommitted; inspect only assigned task files/evidence in a separate read-only card/session
reviewer.isolation: separate card/session; read-only; run after Worker and Tester complete

quick._why: Short tasks or tasks requiring current conversation context stay in Codex.

tester.workspace: same repository directory; serialized after Worker; read-only verifier
tester._why: Independent Tester/Verifier uses OpenCode with edit denied; run after Worker and before Hermes Reviewer. Do not pass --model; preserve OpenCode's configured default.

analystArchitectCoordinator._why: All non-Worker/Reviewer planning roles use Codex's configured defaults.
